items.rationale: Dismantling and refitting needed to place the drying equipment is part of technical drying (5.2.7). Priced at the case 46 level.
Technical drying is covered under 5.2.7; 7 days invoiced sits within the roughly two weeks of drying. Priced from case 46 and the prior (~45/day x 7).
Under 7.4.4 a surcharge is paid only with an itemised material list; the description calls it unexplained. Utilities and ancillaries are already included in the dryer charge (5.2.7).
Standard mineral-wool shell (7.14(c)) to reinstate the pipe insulation. Priced from the prior.
Debris removal is reimbursed once per event (5.2.1); this is the first such charge, so it is the one paid.
Re-levelling the substrate is part of making good (5.2.6). Priced at the case 46 level.
Substrate preparation in the damage area falls under making good, but it may overlap the levelling and labour lines (3.5(d)). Estimated at about 35/m2.
Creating the access opening is covered under 5.2.6. Moderate price for a single opening.
These tiles are within the 90x90 standard threshold (7.14(d)), so they are covered as reinstatement tiling. About 4 m2 against roughly 3 m2 of damage is acceptable with cutting waste.
They exceed the 90x90 tile threshold, so 3.5(f) allows no payment, not even partial. They also duplicate the tiles in line 9 (3.5(d)).
Standard sanitary silicone joints are part of reinstating the tiling. Priced from the prior (~13/m).
One travel charge per contractor per document is reimbursed (7.4.2); this is the first and only one on the tiler's invoice. Priced at the case 46 level.
Labour for repair and retiling is covered. Case 46 proved 14 h at 1260 fair.

items.description: Remove drywall and insulation wool in basement
items.rationale: Removing damaged elements in the damage area is covered (5.2.6/5.2.1). Case 46 paid drywall ~50 plus insulation ~46.
Removing damp plaster in the damage area is covered. The prior gives about 29 per pc.
No damage was established in the attic, and the description calls this work unrelated. It is excluded under 3.5(b) and 7.1.5.
This is the same disposal already charged by the drying firm. Only the first charge is reimbursed (5.2.1, 3.5(d)).
